messages:
maria (docs): Quick sync: we need a short v1->v2 migration playbook + model-swap appendix. Goal: one-page checklist, snippet diffs, alias table, and smoke tests. Keep it lightweight.

tony (sdk): Noted. Breaking change: param rename `stream` -> `streaming`. Recommend canonical snippets use `responses.create` instead of `generate`. I can prepare JS/TS/Python one-liners.

kevin (eng-runtime): I'll upload alias CSV and a small test matrix. Also callout: rwd-embed-compact dims change (1536 -> 1024). Add a note for users who post-process vectors.

jess (techwriter): Ill draft the playbook. Proposed sections: quick checklist, code diffs, alias map, customer-facing FAQ, and reviewer smoke tests. Use minimal examples.

sasha (product): Customers will ask about Dedicated. Can we offer a 60-day compatibility flag? Ill check feasibility and update the doc.

lisa (pm): Tentative dates: public notice 2026-05-10, sunset 2026-07-09. Ill prepare support KB stubs and canned replies.

maria (docs): Good. Include a tiny cURL smoke test in the PR. Example to include: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v2/responses -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-1","input":"hello"}'
```

tony (sdk): Example one-line diffs I'll include: 
# old: client.generate({model:"rwd-chat-1", stream:true}) 
# new: client.responses.create({model:"rwd-chat-1", streaming:true})

kevin (eng-runtime): Linking infra ticket for alias seeding in staging. Will attach to the PR.

docs-bot: PR 4999 created by jess: docs/migration/v1-to-v2-playbook-draft.md -> https://git.redwood/PR/4999

jess (techwriter): Draft up. Please leave inline comments with exact snippet replacements. Ill iterate quickly.

maria (docs): Action items: jess land draft by Fri EOD, tony open SDK PRs, kevin upload alias CSV and tests, sasha confirm Dedicated compatibility window, lisa prep support KB. Thanks! :thumbsup:
